description: This file contains C++ source code implementing HLSL structure translation, including functions for defining structures, handling padding for std140 layout, and generating constructors for structures and built-in types within the ANGLE graphics project.

classes.name: StructureHLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for translating GLSL structures to HLSL, managing structure definitions, constructors, and padding for different memory layouts.

classes.name: Std140PaddingHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing padding calculations in std140 layout for HLSL structures.

methods.name: Define
methods.description: Generates HLSL struct definition string for a given structure, with optional padding.

methods.name: WriteParameterList
methods.description: Creates a comma-separated list of parameter types for constructor functions.

methods.name: getPaddingHelper
methods.description: Returns a new padding helper instance for std140 layout.

methods.name: defineQualified
methods.description: Defines a qualified HLSL struct with optional packing and padding.

methods.name: defineVariants
methods.description: Creates different variants of struct definitions for standard and row-major layouts.

methods.name: ensureStructDefined
methods.description: Ensures a struct is defined, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: addStructConstructor
methods.description: Adds a constructor function for a given structure.

methods.name: addBuiltInConstructor
methods.description: Creates a constructor for built-in types.

methods.name: structsHeader
methods.description: Returns the combined header string of all struct declarations and constructors.

methods.name: storeStd140ElementIndex
methods.description: Stores element index information for a structure in std140 layout.
